high_priority_source_caveats: IITK ch. 2 p. 14 has the wrong positive sign for covariance of distinct SRSWOR inclusion indicators; the correct value is negative.
IITK ch. 2 pp. 17–21 treats normal inference from a fixed finite population as exact; use only with an explicit superpopulation model or as approximation.
Montana printed p. 145 has arithmetic errors in the PPS-WR numerical example; general HT/Hansen–Hurwitz formulas agree with IITK ch. 7.
IITK ch. 9 p. 7 says rho=0 means no error; it means no ICC design-effect inflation, while sampling error remains.
